What they did

Copy prompt
Help me run household logistics this week. Check [email/calendar/folder] for upcoming bills, [child's] activities and appointments, then build a checklist of due dates and amounts, a meal plan for [number] people with a grocery list, and a schedule for [child's] activities. Ask me before paying any bill or sending any message.
